description: Shared catalogue + validation: add the `transport` module key (deps []), the 8 transport.* permission keys + the TRANSPORT_MANAGER template role + ADMIN/STUDENT bindings (15 new role_permission pairs), the 18 transport.* audit keys, and the Transport Zod schemas. Then add the new migration dir to catalogue-sync's SEEDING_MIGRATION_DIRS so the set-equality meta-test passes. Depends on FEAT-001 (the migration seed must already carry the matching permissions/pairs).
steps: In packages/shared/src/modules.ts add `{ key: "transport", name: "Transport", description: "Transport management — vehicles, drivers, routes, stops, assignments, capacity-safe enrollment, maintenance, schedules (Phase 9.4)" }` to MODULES (after the hostel entry) and `transport: []` to MODULE_DEPENDENCIES (after `hostel: []`), with the foundational-not-gated comment (design §K — a gated edge would permanently block activation; prerequisites are validated via composite FKs + in-handler lookups).

In packages/shared/src/permissions.ts append 8 PermissionDefs to PERMISSIONS (after the hostel.view_own entry), each module 'transport': transport.vehicles.manage, transport.drivers.manage, transport.routes.manage, transport.assignments.manage, transport.enrollments.manage, transport.maintenance.manage, transport.view, transport.view_own (descriptions per design §D.1).

In permissions.ts ROLE_PERMISSIONS: add a TRANSPORT_MANAGER role (after WARDEN/HR_MANAGER/EMPLOYEE precedent) bound to the 6 .manage keys + transport.view; append those same 7 staff keys to ADMIN (after its hostel.* keys); append transport.view_own to STUDENT (after hostel.view_own). 15 new pairs total. Separation of duties: STUDENT gets ONLY transport.view_own; no staff role gets transport.view_own.

In packages/shared/src/audit-actions.ts append 18 AuditActionDefs to AUDIT_ACTIONS (after the hostel.* block), each module 'transport' (design §D.3): transport.vehicle.created, transport.vehicle.updated, transport.driver.created, transport.driver.updated, transport.route.created, transport.route.updated, transport.stop.created, transport.stop.updated, transport.assignment.created, transport.assignment.ended, transport.enrollment.created, transport.enrollment.suspended, transport.enrollment.ended, transport.schedule.created, transport.schedule.updated, transport.maintenance.created, transport.maintenance.transitioned, transport.roster.exported. Mirror the hostel comment: DENIED decisions reuse the mutation key with result DENIED (no dedicated .denied keys).

In packages/shared/src/validation.ts append a `// ─── Phase 9.4 Transport Management ───` section after the Phase 9.3 Hostel section (ends ~line 1731). Add enum helpers mirroring the pg enums, a transportCuidLike = z.string().min(1).max(64), and: createVehicleSchema/patchVehicleSchema (registrationNo non-empty; type enum; seatCapacity z.coerce.number().int().min(1); status enum), createDriverSchema/patchDriverSchema (name/licenseNo non-empty; phone/userId optional; status enum), createRouteSchema/patchRouteSchema (name/code non-empty; status enum; feeAmount as a decimal-digit STRING via z.string().regex(/^\d+$/) refined to paise >= 0, optional/nullish on patch — the money-as-string boundary), createStopSchema/patchStopSchema (name non-empty; sequence int>=1; optional landmark/latitude/longitude/pickupOffsetMinutes>=0), createAssignmentSchema (vehicleId, driverId, effectiveFrom date, optional effectiveTo), createEnrollmentSchema (studentId, routeId, stopId), createScheduleSchema/patchScheduleSchema (.refine exactly one of dayOfWeek/date; departureTime 0..1439; optional arrivalTime 0..1439; optional stopId), createMaintenanceSchema (vehicleId, issue non-empty, optional cost>=0) + maintenanceTransitionSchema (toStatus = forward targets only; optional cost/resolutionNote), transportListQuerySchema (page>=1 default 1; pageSize 1..100 default 20; optional status/routeId/vehicleId). Use .strict() on patch objects as hostel does. Export inferred types. No barrel edit needed (index.ts already `export * from "./validation.js"`).
Run the fast suite + build; commit locally on main (do not push).
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build -w @campusgate/api` compiles (ModuleKey/PermissionKey/AuditActionKey unions stay exhaustive and the new Zod types resolve).

`npm test -w @campusgate/api -- src/services/__tests__/catalogue-sync.test.ts` passes: the union of migration-seeded permission keys equals PERMISSION_KEYS and the (role,perm) pairs equal ROLE_PERMISSIONS (exact set-equality), proving the migration seed (FEAT-001) and @campusgate/shared agree.
The full fast suite `npm test -w @campusgate/api` shows no regression in the existing 596 tests.

NAMING NOTE FOR LATER STEPS (FEAT-003 route module): the hostel schemas createMaintenanceSchema / maintenanceTransitionSchema already exist in validation.ts, so the transport equivalents are named createTransportMaintenanceSchema / transportMaintenanceTransitionSchema (with types CreateTransportMaintenanceInput / TransportMaintenanceTransitionInput) to avoid a redeclaration collision. All other transport schema names are collision-free (createVehicleSchema, createDriverSchema, createRouteSchema, createStopSchema, createAssignmentSchema, createEnrollmentSchema, createScheduleSchema, transportListQuerySchema, etc.).

BUILD-SYSTEM NOTE FOR LATER STEPS: @campusgate/shared RESOLVES AT RUNTIME to ./dist/index.js (package.json main/exports import -> ./dist/index.js; types -> ./src/index.ts). Despite context.json saying shared has 'no build step', vitest/node import the COMPILED dist, so after ANY edit to packages/shared/src/*.ts you MUST run `npm run build -w @campusgate/shared` (tsc) before the api build/tests will see the change — otherwise catalogue-sync et al. test against a stale catalogue. (The first catalogue-sync run failed for exactly this reason until shared was rebuilt.)

- `npm test -w @campusgate/api` — 55 files, 596/596 pass, no regression.
